webAiRiskTooltip: Risk is scored 0–100% across four factors: Speed (35% — speeding events from recent driving), Fatigue (25% — nighttime driving & alerts), Weather (15% — seasonal road conditions), Route (25% — safety alerts & incident history). Confidence (30–90%) reflects how much driving data is available — low confidence means few trips or no telemetry. Scores only differentiate once the mobile app logs driving data (speed, nighttime driving, trip duration). Looks back 7 days for driving data, 30 days for safety alerts.
